tool_args.rationale: The observations closely follow a u_now-proportional response across varying x_now, and horizon sensitivity is consistent with the authorized one-state Kelvin–Voigt creep law. Fit its two parameters numerically; the available rows already provide enough independent variation, so no probe is warranted.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary both u_now and H, with a close proportional-to-u response and sufficient temporal variation to fit the two Kelvin–Voigt parameters; additional paid measurements are not justified.
Its asymptotic level depends additively on x_now and u_now, whereas the observed output scales nearly proportionally with u_now despite substantial x_now variation.
Its present-snapshot expression depends on u_now but not H; the supplied slow-horizon signature and observed response are more consistent with a creep law whose output depends on H.
